The original gallery can be found: https://e-hentai.org/g/3607192/764b107e27/

This is just a barely functional translation. Grammatical and/or spelling errors can appear although I've done my best to fix them when I notice them. Granted, I don't really read things properly when I'm in the mood.

Hopefully someone will properly translate and follow the remaining chapters in the future. I didn't know scanlating was so tough. I've translated some chapters for my own use, so this will be the first batch I'll release for now.

Feel free to let me know if you see any issues.
